sequence.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production hand-painted2D tactical RPG animation atlas matching supplied character EXACTLY. A lean adult male human ranger with a readable calm face, dark brown hair, muted moss-green hood and short shoulder mantle, russet brown quilted leather jerkin, dark taupe trousers, gloves and moderate brown boots, quiver behind right shoulder. A plain long wooden bow, with a visibly straight taut bowstring when relaxed and curved limbs, long arrows. Match knight's painted detail and human realism. Camera: orthographic shallow18-degree elevation, DIRECT BACK, entirely facing away, see back of hair and rear armor, no face or chest, same facing in ALL44cells. Maintain functional anatomical handedness; do not mirror weapon hands. Detailed painted brushwork/crisp material edges, warm muted light. Proportional anatomy, gloves, modest sensible boots. True clean transparency, no floor/shadow/text/labels/fringe. Large tall output2048x3840. EXACT4 COLUMNS x11 ROWS,44 separate fully visible figures, generous cell margins including weapons and lying body. SAME body size/head size in every row.
ROW1 four NEUTRAL IDLE breathing poses with relaxed upright straight legs, weapon safely lowered.
ROW2 four COMBAT IDLE breathing poses, weapon prepared forward at chest height.
ROWS3-4 EIGHT-frame natural NEUTRAL WALK loop, alternate left/right heel contact, loading, toe off, passing foot, normal modest stride, credible knee flexion.
ROWS5-6 EIGHT-frame natural COMBAT WALK loop, keep weapon in raised ready guard while feet alternate; never revert to weapon dangling at thigh.
ROWS7-8 EIGHT-frame ATTACK: one bow shot: right hand takes arrow from quiver, nock arrow, raise bow in LEFT hand, RIGHT hand draws string, FULL DRAW at cheek with left arm extended toward facing/target, RELEASE arrow with right hand at cheek, lower bow, ready. One functional bowstring; right hand pulls string not wooden limb.
ROW9 FOUR HIT frames: shoulder struck, recoil, stabilize feet, return guard.
ROWS10-11 EIGHT DEATH/FALL frames: struck, torso buckles, knees bend, knee ground, hand floor, body falls onto side, lands, final full body lying still. No gore. Articulated fall not rigid upright rotation. Fixed camera and facing, full silhouettes. Rows are chronological left to right; no omitted cells. Every sword/shaft remains straight and SAME physical length.

attack_forward.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Production painted2D tactical RPG attack sprite sheet. Match supplied character's face/costume/gear/gloves/proportions/boots EXACTLY. Orthographic18-degree elevated tactical camera, fixed in every cell. Exact4 columns by2 rows,8 full-body frames of ONE action, constant body/head and weapon size. True clean transparent background, no floor/shadows/text/labels/fringe/duplicate limbs/cropped tips. Generous space between figures. Same painted brushwork and muted lighting as reference. Human ranger with brown hair seen from BACK, moss shoulder mantle, brown leather/quiver/bow. Faces and shoots STRAIGHT AWAY FROM VIEWER toward TOP centre of screen in all8frames, NOT to screen-left or screen-right. Back of head/torso visible, NO face. LEFT bow arm extends FORWARD AWAY FROM CAMERA, strongly foreshortened, bow near left/centre front silhouette; RIGHT elbow draws back toward viewer-right, right glove at cheek facing away. Arrow aimed away from camera and foreshortened, shaft largely occluded by torso; do not draw a long leftward/rightward horizontal arrow. Correct working bow/string grip. Eight chronological poses:retrieve arrow,nock,raise toward TOP centre,partial draw,full draw away from viewer,release arrow gone,lower bow,ready. Same rear-view camera all cells.

attack_aim.prompt: Create a corrected 8-frame full-body archery attack sprite sheet for the EXACT SAME painted medieval archer as reference. 4 evenly spaced columns by 2 rows, exactly8 full-body poses read left-to-right row1 then row2. Same face/brown hair, muted moss-green shoulder hood/cloak, brown leather armor, bracers, gloves, quiver and proportional boots, slim realistic build, restrained hand-painted tactical RPG style, shallow tactical camera. EVERY pose faces directly AWAY from viewer; back and hood visible; arrow aims straight away into depth, do NOT aim sideways. The user wants a MUCH more convincing strong bow draw: raised drawing elbow at shoulder level or slightly ABOVE, drawing hand snug against cheek/jaw beside eye, string deeply drawn to face, bow limbs visibly bending under tension, straight supporting bow arm at shoulder height. NOT a short pull to collar or chest, not low elbow. One wooden bow, one rigid arrow only until release, taut string has a clear V to anchored fingers. Frame1 nock at low ready;2 raise bow toward target;3 half draw with rising drawing elbow;4 reach full draw with fingers on cheek and elbow slightly high;5 SAME full draw/aim firmly anchored at cheek, stern focused aim (this frame is held);6 release string fast with drawing hand following backward beside ear, bow springs;7 controlled follow-through empty bow, no arrow in hand/string;8 lower bow and settle. Keep both boots planted at fixed ground contacts and fixed camera/body scale for all8frames, natural stable posture, no side steps or lunge, allow shoulders/torso to articulate. All8 entire silhouettes, bow tips, quiver, boots fit in separate cells without touching. Transparent alpha background, no captions, cell borders, ground plane or painted shadows. Preserve identity and medium from reference, not pixel/chibi/3D/cartoon. Make full-draw frames4&5 strongly readable at native gameplay size.

attack_aim_axial.prompt: Precise corrective animation sheet from this exact archer BACK VIEW reference. Same brown leather archer, moss hood, quiver, proportions and painted game style. Eight full-body drawings arranged4columns x2rows, separated transparent alpha cells. Important: the archer shoots DIRECTLY AWAY FROM CAMERA, to12o'clock into depth. Preserve the reference's AXIAL arm and bow arrangement. Do not rotate the shot to the left or right. No long horizontal arrow shaft anywhere: any arrow is almost entirely FORESHORTENED and hidden behind his head/hands, pointing into the image away from us. Bow remains mostly narrow edge-on behind/left of his head, not a broad full sideways arch occupying the left half of cell. At full draw the left bow arm projects away into depth and is largely occluded by torso/head; right drawing elbow is raised at right shoulder level, right drawing fingers anchored against the unseen right cheek beside his ear. Aiming occurs away from viewer, not to screen left. Frame1 nock/low ready;2 raise bow into depth;3 half draw;4 full tension cheek anchor and high right elbow;5 hold identical aim, strong tension;6 release hand follows back beside right ear, string springs;7 follow-through;8 lower. Standing planted feet, fixed body scale and camera in all8. Show complete bow tips and boots within every cell with clear margins. Restrained original game colors, no white/gray backdrop, no cast shadows, labels or extra figures.
